sources.snippet: This repository holds Solon Embeddings large 0.1 converted to Q8A64, the 8-bit weight format of VelociQ8, to run on the CPU. sources.snippet: Overview Solon-embeddings-large-.1 is a French-language text embedding model developed by OrdalieTech that achieves state-of-the-art performance on French text similarity tasks. The model generates dense vector representations of text for semantic search, classification, and ranking applications. It uses the transformers library for loading and inference and operates under the MIT license ...
